answer: Make trust a pearl that must be forged, not claimed: a newcomer earns it by completing useful work in unrelated domains, each job checked by a different veteran and sealed into a forge ledger that binds every record to one key. No pearl forms from a single dive; it grows layer by layer, and a ripple map traces each layer back to its checker, so a duplicate shows the same signers twice. Deep audits re-open sealed layers, freezing any pearl whose history repeats. Sybil farms must forge a fresh pearl, pass new checkers, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
